listing.description:
Graveyard Tracker keeps count of your cards during a game of Magic: The Gathering, so you always know what is in your library, graveyard and exile.

Import your decklist, then touch and hold any card to move it to the graveyard, exile or back to your library. Made a mistake? Undo your last move.

• Import a decklist by pasting one card per line, such as 1 Sol Ring
• Card details and artwork are downloaded once and kept on your device, so decks work offline after import
• Browse your graveyard and sort it by newest, name or mana value, or filter it by card type
• See at a glance how many card types are in your graveyard for Delirium
• Track statistics about what is in your graveyard
• Rename, edit and reset your decks between games

Private by design: no account, no ads and no tracking. Your decks stay on your device. Card names are looked up using the Scryfall card database.

Graveyard Tracker is unofficial and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Wizards of the Coast. Magic: The Gathering, its card names and card images are property of Wizards of the Coast LLC. Card data and images are provided by Scryfall.

ageRating.note: Target age rating: 13+, matching Wizards of the Coast's guidance for Magic: The Gathering. Answer the age-rating questionnaire in App Store Connect honestly (card artwork can contain fantasy violence); the questionnaire result sets the minimum rating, and a higher rating can be chosen with the age-rating override if the computed one is lower.

review.notes: No account or sign-in is needed. Tap Import, enter any deck name, paste a decklist with one card per line (sample: 1 Sol Ring / 1 Lightning Bolt / 1 Counterspell / 1 Llanowar Elves / 1 Swords to Plowshares / 1 Command Tower), then tap Import. An internet connection is required for import because card data and images come from the Scryfall API (api.scryfall.com). Open the deck, touch and hold a card to move it to the graveyard, then see the Graveyard and Stats tabs. No special hardware or region is required.
